'''Xos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was present on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was being hunted by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
